thread:
Tom H.: heads-up: saw a cluster of SSE stalls around 14:02 UTC where the console showed 'client timeout' but tcpdump shows server FIN then a fast reconnect.
Priya S.: same cluster here. pattern looks like: long pause in server event generation -> proxy closes -> client reconnects and opens new session (counts as billable).
Mark L.: do we have a trace id? can correlate with rate limiter logs.
Tom H.: traces: t=8b9f1c, session=svc-3b2. Console event: event_id=evt-20260321-1402.
Nisha (SRE): quick grep on proxy logs shows "idle-evict" for px-21 at 14:02:17, but server sent last-event at 14:02:12. proxy_idle_threshold=5s in px config.
Priya S.: our client SDK uses reconnect_jitter=300-600ms, so duplicate session windows are small but frequent. This explains double token-metering seen in billing dashboard.
Tom H.: repro snippet (SSE client):
```js
fetch(url, {headers: {Authorization: token}}).then(res => {
  const s = new EventSource(url);
  s.onmessage = (e) => {};
  // client heartbeats disabled because we rely on server events
});
```
Mark L.: root causes: (1) proxy idle threshold too low relative to server event interval under GC, (2) console labels only show "disconnect_reason=client_timeout" derived from client heartbeat, not proxy-initiated.
Nisha (SRE): ops note: px-21 is on an old binary that has aggressive conn pruning during mem-pressure. We scheduled upgrade last week but rolled out partial.
Priya S.: UX ask: can dashboard show "reconnect_billing_impact=likely" if reconnects per-minute > 50 and average session lifetime < 10s? customers are getting angry.
dash-bot: metric metadata: reconnect_count, session_open, session_close, disconnect_reason (values: client, server). No proxy field currently.
Mark L.: propose changes: add disconnect_initiator label (client|proxy|server), and a derived flag billing_dedup_hint when reconnects cause repeated auth exchanges.
Tom H.: implementation plan: small edge agent patch to emit X-Edge-Id and close_origin on close frame; console to synthesize billing_dedup_hint via stream analytics; feature gated for private installs.
Nisha (SRE): careful: adding X-Edge-Id in headers could leak topology to customers in private deployments. Must be opt-in and redacted per org policy.
Priya S.: also suggestion: add a routing fallback to prefer newer proxy pool when route.weight change > 0.2 in rolling deploys, to avoid hitting stale nodes.
Mark L.: can we hotfix px config to raise proxy_idle_threshold to 12s on edge-a/eu for now?
Nisha (SRE): yes, we can bump to 12s; doing a gradual change to avoid keeping stale sockets open everywhere. ops run: infra-bot, apply px config change to edge-a/eu.
infra-bot: applying config: px_idle_threshold=12s -> edge-a/eu; change propagated to 3/4 nodes, ETA 90s.
Tom H.: after bump, initial telemetry: reconnect_count dropped ~65% for affected route. console still shows disconnect_reason=client for some events.
Priya S.: dashboard change request: when disconnect_initiator=proxy is missing but px upgrade shows evicted nodes >50% in window and reconnect rate drops after threshold bump, display \"likely proxy-eviction\" banner.
Mark L.: sounds good as a short-term UX patch. Long-term we need proper labels. Add alert: if reconnects >200/min and billing_rate_increase >10% open SEV.
Nisha (SRE): created INF-TKT-1102 to track agent header propagation and policy gating. Link: https://internal.redwood/INF-TKT-1102
Tom H.: I'll run a 2% canary with close_origin header emit and check dash for correct labeling.
Priya S.: thanks. Also will add a tooltip in the billing view that explains reconnect+auth churn can inflate token counts.
Mark L.: leaving follow-up to persist proxy_id in long-term retention for correlation (90d).
infra-bot: canary deploy 7400001234-propagate-close-origin -> edge-a (2%) succeeded.
Tom H.: canary shows close_origin=proxy for 93% of the suspicious events. dash now surfaces billing_dedup_hint=true for route/tenant beta.
Priya S.: great, let's coordinate a customer comms draft if we confirm billing corrections.
Nisha (SRE): rolling px binary upgrade to remaining nodes tonight after maintenance window.
Tom H.: closing for now, will reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
